data.name: Fetch a Specific Refund for a Payment
data.description: You can use this API to retrieve details of a specific refund made for a payment.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves details for one refund associated with a payment. Use the response to inspect refund status and attributes.
Use for: inspect a refund, verify refund details, look up refund status
Not supported: creating refunds, updating refunds, listing all refunds

data.name: Refund a payment
data.description: Refunds a payment that has been captured, and returns a unique reference for this request. You get the outcome of the request asynchronously, in a REFUND webhook.  You can refund either the full captured amount or a part of the captured amount. You can also perform multiple partial refunds, as long as their sum doesn't exceed the cap
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a full or partial refund for a captured payment. The refund result is delivered asynchronously through a webhook.
Use for: refund a payment, issue a partial refund, issue multiple partial refunds
Not supported: refunding uncaptured payments, retrieving refund details, synchronously confirming the outcome

data.name: Create a Normal Refund
data.description: You can use this API to create a normal refund for a payment.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a standard refund for a payment and returns a refund reference. Use it to return all or part of a captured payment.
Use for: create a refund, refund a captured payment, issue a partial refund
Not supported: retrieving refund details, cancelling refunds, refunding uncaptured payments

data.name: Refund captured payment
data.description: Refunds a captured payment, by ID. For a full refund, include an empty payload in the JSON request body. For a partial refund, include an amount object in the JSON request body.
data.evaluateGuide:
Refunds a captured PayPal payment by capture identifier. An empty payload performs a full refund; an amount payload performs a partial refund.
Use for: refund a capture, issue a full refund, issue a partial refund
Not supported: refunding uncaptured payments, retrieving refund status, cancelling refunds

data.name: Create an Instant Refund
data.description: You can use this API to process refunds instantaneously to your customers.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates an instantaneous refund for a payment. Use it to process a customer refund through Razorpay.
Use for: issue an instant refund, refund a payment, return customer funds
Not supported: retrieving refund details, refunding uncaptured payments, listing refunds

data.name: Get refund payment rails
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the payment rails associated with a refund. Use the response to identify how the refund is routed.
Use for: inspect refund rails, identify refund routing, retrieve rail details
Not supported: creating refunds, modifying refunds, retrieving general refund status

data.name: GET /v2/processing/invoices/{invoiceID}/payments/{paymentID}/refunds/{refundID}
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves a specific refund within an invoice payment. Use the response to inspect that refund's details.
Use for: inspect a refund, verify refund details, look up a payment refund
Not supported: creating refunds, updating refunds, listing all refunds

data.name: Refund captured payment
data.description: Refunds a captured payment, by ID. For a full refund, include an empty payload in the JSON request body. For a partial refund, include an amount object in the JSON request body.
data.evaluateGuide:
Refunds a captured PayPal payment by capture identifier. An empty payload performs a full refund; an amount payload performs a partial refund.
Use for: refund a capture, issue a full refund, issue a partial refund
Not supported: refunding uncaptured payments, retrieving refund status, cancelling refunds
